messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - GPU pool exhaustion detected (us-west-2). autoscaler: HPA failed to scale GPU deployments for the past 6m. Queue length spiked from ~20 -> 480. Notifying on-call.

sre_oncall_jess: I see the alert. Checking autoscaler and metrics adapters now. Customers reporting high latency and 429 throttles.

eng_runtime_raj: On the dashboard: GPU util at 99%, pending pods stuck Pending with InsufficientGPU, kube-scheduler can't place. HPA metrics: observedReplicas not increasing.

ml_platform_chen: Metrics pipeline looks lagged. Prometheus scraping ok, but prometheus-adapter has 5m scrape backlog and adapter shows errors: "error querying prom: context deadline". Could be network pile-up between prometheus and adapter.

prod_support_ana: PS - multiple customers in us-west-2 are seeing generation timeouts and queued requests. I'm triaging high-value accounts, notifying CS.

sre_oncall_jess: Running quick checks: 
```
kubectl get hpa -n inference gpu-worker-hpa -o yaml
kubectl get deployment gpu-worker -n inference -o wide
kubectl describe pod -n kube-system prometheus-adapter-*
```

sre_oncall_jess: describe shows adapter crashloops 3x in last 10m with error about upstream query latency. logs show timeouts.

eng_runtime_raj: The HPA relies on custom metric: queue_length_per_replica. If adapter returns 500 or times out, HPA can't compute desiredReplicas -> no scale. That matches the observed stalling.

ml_platform_chen: I can temporarily switch HPA to use resource/memory ratio as fallback, but need quick change. Also can increase maxReplicas to give scheduler headroom, but we are hitting cluster GPU quota too.

sre_oncall_jess: Immediate mitigation plan: 
1) Open incident (this thread).
2) Manual scale gpu-worker to +5 replicas if scheduler can place (kubectl scale).
3) If pods Pending due to InsufficientGPU, trigger cross-region traffic shift for new requests to us-east-1.
4) Restart prometheus-adapter pod (to clear backlog) and monitor metric latency.
5) If adapter still fails, flip HPA to fallback metric (resource) and roll back later.

eng_runtime_raj: I'll attempt a restart of prometheus-adapter and check cluster quotas.

ml_platform_chen: I'll prepare a one-line HPA patch to switch to resource-based metric, ready to apply if adapter doesn't recover in 3m.

prod_support_ana: Notifying top 10 impacted customers and escalating where necessary. Draft message ready.

eng_runtime_raj: Restarted prometheus-adapter (kubectl rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter -n kube-system). Logs show it came up but still slow - queries timing out against Prometheus; Prometheus CPU spiking.

sre_oncall_jess: Check Prometheus for query latency and ingesters. Could be TSDB compaction or high label cardinality from recent churn.

ml_platform_chen: Prometheus has a bunch of stalled remote_write and long GC pauses reported. I'm increasing query timeout for adapter to 30s as a temporary stopgap. Patch applied.

eng_runtime_raj: After timeout increase, adapter started returning metrics but with 30-45s latency. HPA now sees metrics intermittently. DesiredReplicas jumped to 40 but cluster quota prevents new GPU pods.

sre_oncall_jess: Cluster GPU quota is at 200, currently used=199. Who requested recent capacity allocation?

ml_platform_chen: I see a recent autoscale burst from batch jobs (team: research) consuming GPUs. I can identify and evict low-priority batch pods if agreed.

sre_oncall_jess: Evicting non-critical batch is approved. Please cordon/taint nodes hosting batch if necessary. We must free GPUs for inference.

eng_runtime_raj: Evicting research batch pods now (kubectl delete pod --namespace research ...) - deleting ~8 pods, freeing 12 GPUs. Pod termination logs: 
```
Deleting pod research-job-12 (grace 30s)
Evicted due to priority/pressure
```

sre_oncall_jess: After eviction, scheduler placed 6 new gpu-worker pods. Queue reduced from 480 -> 120 over 4m. Latency for queued requests dropping. Still seeing 429s for some customers.

prod_support_ana: Sent update to customers: "We're mitigating a GPU capacity issue in us-west-2, routing and scaling steps ongoing. ETA ~20-30m." Customers asked for region failover instructions.

oncall_next_ben: I'm taking handoff in 15m. Any outstanding tasks I should own?

sre_oncall_jess: Tasks before handoff: 
- Monitor HPA metric stability and adapter error rate.
- Confirm GPU usage <= 95% and queue <50 for 10 consecutive minutes.
- If adapter errors return, apply HPA fallback patch (ml_platform_chen has ready).
- Keep CS updates every 15m.

ml_platform_chen: Preparing HPA fallback patch now (resource-based) in case adapter degrades again. Patch snippet: 
```
spec:
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 65
```

eng_runtime_raj: Prometheus query load is stabilizing after removing batch pods, adapter latency -> 8-12s. HPA desiredReplicas now 28 and cluster has capacity for 25 more GPUs. Autoscaler resuming.

sre_oncall_jess: Good. Marking mitigation progress: manual evictions + timeout bump + restart adapter helped. Need root cause investigation: why prometheus load spiked and why adapter didn't degrade gracefully.

prod_support_ana: Customers acknowledged update; one enterprise customer requested SLA credit request path. Logged it to support queue.

oncall_next_ben: I'll take the shift. If metrics regress, I'll apply ml_platform_chen fallback and coordinate quota increase with infra. Contact: @ben-oncall.

sre_oncall_jess: Handoff: current status - GPU util 85%, queue 32, HPA healthy, prometheus-adapter error rate low. CS messages sent. Leaving incident open for postmortem.

alice_sales: Any impact to demo customers? We had a live trial in us-west-2 at 13:00. Need a note to reschedule if degraded.

prod_support_ana: Noted, sending targeted note to Alice, copying product.

customer_success_mike: I'll follow up with impacted customers and collect any examples of failures for the postmortem.

sre_oncall_jess: Incident classified P1. Action items logged:
- Root cause: investigate Prometheus query load source (label cardinality, remote_write, batch job churn).
- Improve adapter resilience: circuit-breaker + cached last-known metrics for HPA fallback.
- Review cluster GPU quota policy and preemption rules.
- Run a tabletop for GPU exhaustion scenarios.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-15T13:17:00Z created, status: active, incident-owner: sre_oncall_jess, sev: P1.

sre_oncall_jess: I'm closing the immediate mitigation phase. Handoff to noncall_next_ben for monitoring and postmortem. If anything flares up, escalate to oncall+eng-runtime.

oncall_next_ben: Taking over. I'll keep this thread updated in 15m or earlier if anything changes.

incident-bot: NOTE: Please file postmortem at /incidents/postmortems/ with timeline + impact buckets.

sre_oncall_jess: End of incident shift notes: manual evictions, adapter restart, timeout increase, HPA resumed. Root cause suspected: Prometheus load spike from research batch causing adapter timeouts -> delayed HPA decisions -> queue growth -> GPU exhaustion.

noncall_next_ben: Acknowledged. Will start a follow-up ticket for mitigation and schedule postmortem.
